# BD-CMR — Bio-Digital Closed-Loop Myocardial Regeneration

> An open, browser-based research prototype for transparent cardiovascular simulation, uncertainty, provenance, and role-aware research workflows.

## Project summary

BD-CMR is research and education software. It demonstrates how simulated evidence, limitations, provenance, and safety boundaries can be made visible in a cardiovascular research interface. It includes synthetic myocardial-infarction learning scenarios, procedural anatomy, and illustrative regeneration projections.

## Safety and scope

- BD-CMR is not a medical device, clinical system, diagnostic classifier, or source of treatment advice.
- It does not ingest or retain EHR, FHIR, DICOM, PHI, or production clinical data.
- Anatomy is schematic and procedural, not patient-specific.
- Outputs are illustrative simulations and must not be used for diagnosis, prognosis, treatment selection, or patient management.
